name: TextAttack
hook: NLP adversarial-attack framework from the QData lab (ACL 2020).
what_atr_did: Issue #824 proposes a textattack-detection-atr companion PyPI package — plugin-shaped, zero core changes. Single ask: README cross-link.

name: Microsoft PyRIT
hook: The toolkit Microsoft uses internally to red-team production LLM products. Roman Lutz leads.
what_atr_did: Added an ATR dataset loader exposing the rule corpus as PyRIT attack sources; PR #1715 merged 2026-05-27.

name: HackAPrompt
org: Schulhoff et al. — Learn Prompting · EMNLP 2023
hook: The largest crowd-sourced prompt-injection competition corpus, 4,780 competition samples across GPT/Claude/PaLM. EMNLP 2023 best-paper nominee.
what_atr_did: Clustered 4,780 HackAPrompt samples by attack family. Shipped 5 ATR rules (ATR-2026-00452..00456) from dominant clusters. HackAPrompt recall moved 28.6% → 66.2% across that sprint (2026-05-12, before detection lanes existed, with every rule loaded: what the hunt lane loads today), measured on the same corpus those rules were mined from, so it is an in-sample gain, not a measure of generalisation. The corpus is 100% adversarial and carries no benign population, so it yields no precision or false-positive figure. Each rule cites the HackAPrompt cluster in metadata_provenance.

name: NeMo-Guardrails + llm-guard + Promptfoo
hook: Vendor test suites from three production guardrail systems. Combined 94 adversarial samples covering jailbreak, injection, and output sanitization.
what_atr_did: Ingested combined 94-sample corpus. Shipped 6 ATR rules (ATR-2026-00500..00505) covering attack patterns present across all three vendor test suites. Each rule validated against the vendor's own test cases as true-positive ground truth.

name: OWASP LLM Top 10 + MITRE ATLAS PoCs
hook: Standards-defined PoC attack patterns from OWASP LLM01-LLM10 and corresponding MITRE ATLAS technique catalog (AML.T00XX series).
what_atr_did: Shipped 8 ATR rules (ATR-2026-00510..00517), each mapping to a named OWASP LLM category (LLM01-LLM10) and a specific MITRE ATLAS technique. Rules are standards-aligned at the metadata_provenance level.

name: Promptfoo
hook: Open-source LLM red-teaming and evaluation tool. Promptfoo generates and runs adversarial tests against LLM applications.
what_atr_did: PR #8529 adds an MCP red-team example using ATR as the deterministic defense layer. Promptfoo runs the probe; ATR rules return the verdict.
